nom: Drunk Elephant C-Firma Fresh Vitamin-C Day Serum

avis.texte: This serum is the best. I didnt like it at first, the smell os very weird and the texture takes a minute to get used to. Besides that… holy cow this thing is amazing! It has help lift the appearance of acne scars on my face, it has made my skin tone even, and i truly believe it has helped with the bounce of my skin. Worth the money.

avis.titre: Could not get past the smell.
avis.texte: I couldn't get past the smell I don't understand why you have a product that smells so horrible in today's times?? so as far as whether the product work couldn't tell you cause I couldn't get past the smell I threw it away. And the time that I did put it on my skin it burned like crazy. I do have super sensitive skin but this was a no go for me.

avis.titre: Don't want to live without this!!
avis.texte: AMAZING!!!! I hope I have this on subscription because I never want to be without it. Between this and the framboos and the barrier cream andProtini I have been getting so many compliments that I look much younger than I am. I haven't heard that in a long time!!

I've been using this product for several years. The ingredients are effective and the new packaging is an improvement because my vitamin c stays fresh until I'm ready to use it. It is very important with vitamin c to allow it to soak completely into your face before you layer moisturizer on top. Be patient and wait until the stickiness completely absorbs into the skin.

avis.titre: I would never buy this again
avis.texte: I thought it was crazy I had to mix the formulas together. The pump does not work at all so I can't review the actual product

avis.titre: Way too tacky on my skin
avis.texte: I have been using this for a few days now. I am not new to Vitamin C serums. I have used several over the years. This one, by far, is the tackiest and stickiest feeling I have tried! At first, I liked the fact that you could mix it up. I did find the instructions to be a tiny bit small to read. The serum stays sticky on my face the entire day. I use it in the morning as the first thing that hits my skin. I am wondering if that is making it hard for the other products to absorb, since this one doesn't seem to sink in; it just sits on my skin, tacky and sticky. I will really try to use this up; I am not thrilled. I will go back to my other C serum that I used prior to this purchase!

avis.titre: Good results, but too watery for me
avis.texte: I followed the instructions exactly and this serum is much more watery than I expected. It's a little difficult to apply, especially in contrast to the B-Hydra intensive hydration serum, which I LOVE.

i've been using this for over 5 years and every time I've tired a new brand I come back to this one. I think it's worth the price and honestly it lasts me about 6 months and that's with me using it every day.
Like this product and how it makes my skin feel when I put it on before my moisturizers in the morning.

avis.titre: not a bad product! (with one caveat)
avis.texte: just wanted to start out by saying that i think this is a good product. i use this in tandem with other products (which might be doing the real work) and i haven't been using it for too long. nonetheless, i have to assume it's doing something; besides, i didnt have any vitamin c in my routine (or a routine) before this. BUT i just want to warn some potential buyers about something strange. it smells like sausages? i don't know why. is it my product? is it the vitamin C? why does it smell like sausages?
Love the vitamin C. My skin soaks it up and makes my face brighter and more even toned. Slightly tingles. Easy to apply.

I've only been using this for six weeks. I like the way it feels on my skin. I probably need more time to see if it will significantly lighten sun spots. My only complaint is the smell. It would be nice if there is something that could be added to improve the smell that does no harm. I don't think I'll buy it again at this price point because the smell is so off-putting.

After months of trying to find a more affordable dupe for this product I caved and subscribed because my sensitive skin combined with the results I was trying to achieve I just couldn't find anything to match the results I was getting with this. The product instantly absorbs into my skin and I can see immediate results in the smoothness, plumpness and overall more even-toned appearance of my face. My forehead wrinkles are less deep and do not appear as much. It truly does make everything firmer! The only thing I'm not a fan of is the bottle because it is hard to get all of the product out once it gets low and you have to be careful using the pump so it doesn't spray and waste it. But other than that I just can't say no to it!
I use this multiple times per week and did a lot of research on vitamin c options before committing to this one. I will definitely keep buying! You can see the results instantly but also over time.
I have been using this product for a few years now. I love how it makes my skin feel and look.
I use this daily, as my AM regimen and my face is still mate, throughout the day!

avis.titre: Product is ok, packaging is terrible.
avis.texte: This product is sticky and smells like cloves, and causes slight burning. Do yourself a favor and mix it in the clear vial and screw the cap back on and don't attempt to use the pump, the instructions are unintelligible. Arghh!! Not worth the annoyance.
Love, love, love. The one thing in my routine that will never change, because the few times I've taken it out I've noticed a difference in texture, tone, and moisture.
I use this product once a week. I like the packaging it helps to keep it from oxidizing.

avis.titre: I would not spend my money on this.
avis.texte: I think this was very sticky and frying on my face. I threw it out.

I absolutely love this vitamin C. In the past, I used one that was over double the price. I came accross this one and fell in love. It has a similar ingredient profile and delivers the same if not better results. I like that you mix it once you start using it. I feel like that ensures the potency is at its maximum. Love you DE, keep making stellar products please:)

avis.titre: Do you want to smell like ham?
avis.texte: This is the worst smelling thing I have ever put on my face, with the absolute worst texture. Just rub an Easter ham on your face, it is cheaper.

I did not realize you have to mix this yourself . This does not smell good. My skin broke out after using this serum. I did not care for this product and returned it. I expected a better product from Drunk Elephant .

avis.titre: The absolute best. Most effective L-Ascorbic Acid ingredient
avis.texte: Drunk Elephant (DE) created this innovative formulation where you get to be the chemist and mixologist to make the freshest, most potent Vitamin C serum you can get. As a long time user, I recommend making a DE smoothie. This product pairs so well with their B-Hydra serum. Just one pump of C-Firma in the palm of you hand plus 1 pump of B-Hydra, mix with your finger tips and apply to your face, and save what's left on your palm for your forehead. It just mixes to the perfect consistency and then applies beautifully. And I promise you, I'm over 55, and I have tried every Vitamin C serum out there (including the unaffordable Skinceuticals one that actually sued DE for patent infringement and then settled - things that make you go hmmm! This one is the most effective for the cost even at full price. But here at Ulta you can often find a steal!

I am surprised Drunk Elephant allowed this product to market. The fact that you have to mix it yourself with no funnel gives way to inconsistent product for each user. There was no funnel so you have to do the best you can without out spilling and hope you got enough of the liquid to mix the powder correclty.

I honestly can't even review the efficacy of the product because the smell is terrible. It smells incredibly sour and the smell lingers the entire day. I couldn't stand using it for more than a few hours. May be good, but never know.

I like the packaging, and mixing fresh C serum. It smells funky, but that is lessened by keeping it in the fridge. It is sticky after drying, so I fix that with spf cream application on top. I like the DE C cream better. I will try less expensive options next.

Almost 4 yrs using this and let me tell you, its worth every penny. The formula is amzing. It does have a very very mild scent and a little stick, as a good vitamic c usuay does. I mix with bhydra and it gives the most insane glassy finish. Addressed my sun spots and firmed my skin.
The scent is foul. Unfortunately I can't get past it to keep using the product.
No matter where in my routine I apply this it always leaves a sticky orange cast on my skin that is noticeable even through foundation.

Works well with my o other products, but honestly, I'm sure there's something that works as well or better. There's nothing spectacular about the way it works that makes me want to purchase another bottle or stick with it. Especially because is so terrible and the product is so sticky it does not go on easily. I will probably not purchase this again. I like the other drunk elephant, vitamin C product much better.

My bff and I both have this product, and we have two different skin types. Both of us experienced pilling. We put it on after a freshly washed face and then let it dry. Then we put our moisturizer on. Later on in the day we may scratch our face or something, and it peels off. Love the packaging of the product, very cool pump, but not worth the hefty price tag.

I have been using this product for 2 weeks. It seems to have brightened up my skin. I hope that it will lighten up my sun spots after longer use. I do not like how it leaves my skin sticky for a while after use.

This vitamin C serum has been really good/helpful to my skin,glad that my dermatologist recommended this product, definitely works as described for brightening the skin/hyperpigmentation etc, only issue with this product is that it is kind of pricey

after reading many reviews, I bought this and after the first use, the smell is horrible! The price point on this product is too high for it to smell like this. I tried changing my routine, using it at night instead of the morning so I wouldn't have to smell it all day, but I just can't. Also, it has a gritty texture when applying.
I really, really want to like this but it smells so bad and the smell does not fade. Does it work? I have no idea because I use it once and it takes weeks for me to be willing to smell it again.

I have been using this for about 3 years; I absolutely love it. I suffered from melasma, and this has definitely helped clear my dark spots. It hydrates and leaves my skin so smooth and works great with my Sunscreen.

I've been using for about 1 1/2 weeks and this product has already brighten and toned my skin. It's very powerful and not for the sensitive skins types. So if I exfoliate my skin, I will wait a day before using this to prevent over tingling. If I am using Retinol A I also skin a day or two and rotate the use of this product. You have to be careful using this product and know how to and when to use. The worst thing is that because its very potent, it smells like lighter fluid a bit but it ok with me because I didn't choose the product for the smell of it, I choose for the results I knew I'd get.

My oh my. It's like fresh squeezed orange juice for the skin. My face loves this serum. The whole concept of mixing it fresh is revolutionary in skin care. I have been using this product in the travel kit to test out this skin care line and it is absolutely fabulous. I love this.

avis.titre: I would love to buy this product again
avis.texte: It's an amazing product I see the change on my face gives me glowing help me with the brown spots I've been using it for a while and I like to continue using it

I researched this product and it had many great reviews. No where in those reviews was there any mention of how awful this product smells. I am highly disappointed as it's not cheap. I had to switch it out for another product (and another brand). I can't stand it!

avis.titre: I would not buy this product again because of the smell
avis.texte: The product makes skin glow, but it smells of smoke. This is unpleasant for me and the nearest and unfortunately can last for the entire day.
Was recommended by my dermatologist and I like how it makes my skin seem brighter
Really love this. When combined with B hydra, a nice light moisturizer duo. My one wish? Sell as a refill option so that we don't have so much plastic waste.
I gave this a shot, since I love their protini and hydration serum. The smell and consistency was a bit off and after using for 2-3 weeks and ended up breaking out :/

The packaging for this product is horrible. Despite following the directions, this did not mix completely and there is no way to stir it. Less than a month in and I'm barely getting any product out anymore. Tried to take the bottle apart to see what was happening and now the nozzel won't go back on at all. This product may be amazing but I'll never know since the packaging is so horrible.

avis.titre: Amazing product use daily and the results are amazing
avis.texte: One of my favorite Drunk Elephant products I have been using this product for years. AM refresher,

Ive repurchased this at least 5 times already because its the only one that works for me. A lot of people don't know this, but this vitamin C has 15%. That can be a lot for some people that are just starting to use vitamin C. When I started, my skin was a bit irritated because it wasn't used to how strong it was, but since it's adjusted, it leaves me the prettiest glow and honestly brightens my face sooo much. I've tried many, and this is the only one that works for me. Only use during day and never in eye area. Literally the best. This is the only product I use from this brand, and it's honestly made the biggest improvement in my skin.

avis.titre: Got to have this in your skincare routine!!!!
avis.texte: I use this in my morning skincare routine every day. It mixes well with the other products I use in the morning and has definitely helped give my skin a brighter appearance. My coworkers comment all the time how nice my skin looks.
I do not care for this product, I actually ordered the wrong item. I don't like having to mix product. This product feels very sticky and tacky on my skin.

avis.titre: The worst vit C serum ever
avis.texte: Extremely sticky, very strong smell, got bad very quickly. The price for this product is insane
I use this during that before moisturizer or sunscreen. I really like it. Haven't used it long enough to but so far so good, only using a couple weeks.

Having now ordered 3 bottles, I can say with confidence that this VitaminC serum is one of the best I have used. The fact that it is mixed at the time of use reduces the oxidation so greatly, that alone is brilliant. I knew this serum was potent when I felt that known "tingling" on my skin upon application. Not an uncomfortable feeling at all, just the way it should feel when a serum contains a high quality and concentration of VitC. So I will continue to use it every morning with my skin routine, and highly recommend it.

avis.titre: CE FERULIC WHO?? THIS IS AWESOME
avis.texte: WAS SURPRISED TO MIX MYSELF BUT IM A BELIEVER IN THIS DAILY. MY SKIN LOOKS BRIGHTER AND BETTER THAN EVER.

avis.titre: Love the product. Hate the juvenile packaging
avis.texte: Love the products. Hate the packaging. Please level up and make it sophisticated
I've used this serum for several years now. I love how I mix it myself, so I dont have to worry about shelf life. My skin looks amazing!
gives skin a glow! feels so nice mixed with protini moisturizer and b- hydra!

avis.titre: Can not get past the smell.
avis.texte: I love other Drunk Elephant products, but the smell of this one was too offensive. I didn't mind the mixing part, and the texture was a little tacky, but I could deal with that if the product was great. But that smell.... I can't get past that smell. It's a hard NOPE for me.
I used this product for 3 months and did absolutely nothing for my skin.
Top is misaligned. Won't dispense each time. I hate the overdone plastic packaging! Product is tacky but ok

Previously, I used another brand's Vitamin C serum. They all start with a pungent orange scent, which dissipates throughout the day. Where Drunk Elephant's C-Firma differs is that by the evening, the smell starts coming back, but even more pungent than before. I would correlate the scent with a skunky smell. I will not reorder C-Firma.

avis.titre: I will continue to buy C firma
avis.texte: I've been using the C-firma for several years. It's my go to serum. I feel likevit has helped my age spots/ sun damage from years in the sun in my youth.

This product seems to work well. The serum is a bit sticky when first applied. My biggest complaint is the packaging, which is pretty awful. I don't mind having to mix it but putting the orange caps back on was a challenge and I could not get the outer cap back on. The directions for putting the caps on are sorely lacking. A short video on mixing and capping would be so helpful. The product seems effective and doesn't irritate my stupid-sensitive skin, so 4 stars.
Drunk Elephant gets is right with every product. No brainer Vitamin C serum….My skin is so happy and looks great for 61 based on what others tell me. It's great.

avis.titre: I love using this in my skin cocktail.
avis.texte: I have used this product for about 2 weeks. I can tell a different in my skin.

I've noticed an improvement in my skin tone after using this product for a week. This vitamin c doesn't smell the best, but it quickly fades away. I use this in the morning and pair it with the B Hydra serum.
I'm 48 and it's my first time using vitamin C of any kind on my face. In less than 30 days, my turkey neck wrinkles have reduced significantly.
Love it so far my skin and eyes are very sensitive to facial all facial products. So it's been difficult to find products that work this product works well 😊

avis.titre: My skin looks tan after three day use
avis.texte: I cant believe this. I bought a travel skincare pack because i needed something for an upcomimg trip. I used the vit c product that you have to mis together. Three days later and my skin os glowing and looks tan. I am blown away. Ive never had a product work this quick.

when i receive my package ,package look good but when i open the package the product box not seal and one product box open and ruin the product too . i spend so i want to seal the box but very disappointed

avis.titre: Would never buy again esp for price
avis.texte: be aware you need to mix the two together. Good luck trying to get the cap on so it twists correctly without losing a lot of this costly C. It also has a smell and is somewhat sticky. Worth the high price? Not for me.

I wanted to love it, unfortunately it is super tacky/sticky and remains that way, it does not dry. It's like having dried honey all over my face, There is no way I would be able to wear this under my makeup, this is going back!

I have had 3 people in 4 days tell me my skin is glowing and looks so good. It leaves my face looking even, glowy, healthier. I put bora barrier on over it and I only use it at night. I highly recommend.

avis.titre: I will try again to give a chance to see if there's progress
avis.texte: I use it usually 2X/day, always at night, followed by night cream or day lotion with sunscreen. I dries immediately, almost too soon. I little stingy...but I do have sensitive skin, but no an irritant. I've only been using it maybe 2 wks. Don't feel that is long again to see noticable changes. I will probaly re-order to give it some time.

I have never had to write a review as negative on any skincare/cosmetic product as this. This came as a free gift along with 2 other serums from Drunk Elephant. I have normal type skin at the age of 68 and these serums were not only sticky but made my skin feel dry and taut and pulling.. What the? Whoever formulated this might have been drunk!~ Hence, the name. This is purely my experience I regret to say- One of the gals that works at Ulta, who is far younger than me had a similar experience. Yes, it does have a funky scent but I could bypass that if the product was decent enough. I have given this 2 months chance.. Instead of going on my skin it's going in the trash very soon as I have lost patience. Luckily, this was a free gift.

I cannot believe how quickly I noticed a drastic difference in my skin. Only one week. It is clearer, firmer and absolutely brighter. I've had multiple people say it's the best my skin has looked and when I'm not wearing any makeup. I don't even feel the need to put on much makeup this last week. I've tried many serums. This by far is the best I've used. Highly recommend!

I've tried many popular vit c serums - skinceuticals, Timeless, Maelove, Paula's choice, Sunday Riley and more and I've found that drunk elephants vit c does not have the offensive smell many others do. It doesn't sting, cause redness or itching. I don't understand all the negative reviews about the smell - I am seeing results and smell is minimal compared to alternatives. It's the best on the market to reduce dark spots, build collagen and elastin. Well formulated! Thank you!

This was in a package set with 2 other DE serums for the Feb diamond day gift. Never used DE before then and I dont think I will after trying these. This one in particular smells like hot dog water - I literally had to wash my face and redo my skjncare because it smelled that bad. There are much better smelling vitamin c options out there that are also more affordable. Don't even waste your time

This was in a package set with 2 other DE serums for the Feb diamond day gift. Never used DE before then and I dont think I will after trying these. The only reason I bought this is because it came with a midi set and I love the other two products in the set. My facial skin hates Vitamin C; no matter what form I use it does the opposite of what it's supposed to do (most of the brown spots on my face are from using vitamin C), so I'm only using it in my neck. Not a fan of the watery, sticky texture, but the worst thing is the smell. It smells exactly like bacon, which I don't eat, so I *really* don't like smelling it on my neck. I'll review again if it actually works on my neck. At this point it's too early to tell.

avis.titre: Love the product but leaky packaging
avis.texte: Love this vitamin c serum and have repurchased several times. I definitely noticed a difference in my skin when I started using it. It's light weight, not too sticky and makeup layers well over it. Originally the product didn't require any mixing but now it comes in a liquid and powder that you mix when you are ready to start using it to preserve freshness. The first time I received it since the change, no issues. The second time the package leaked sooo much. I tried everything to make sure it was sealed correctly but I probably lost about half the product due to leaking. I stopped traveling with it, thinking it'd be better if I kept it upright but even that didn't resolve the issue, it still leaked product out around the pump. As much as I love the formula, for the price I can't justify the risk of it happening again. Big bummer.
I bought the full sized bottle to use it every morning. I found that it's quite sticky. Definitely not easy to put any make up on top of, and even without, it's too sticky for me. Night use is better

avis.titre: got rid of my eye bags
avis.texte: I had pretty noticeable eye bags, started using this under my eyes (would take a q tip and dip it into the bottle then apply under eyes) and my bags are completely gone. however, it has dried my eyes a lot. I'm sure if I start using moisturizer more often in this area it will help though
This product is sticky and smells bad. Even hours after application I get an unpleasant whiff of it.
I've only been using it a week and I am completely hooked. My face has never looked so glowy and full of moisture! I also struggle with acne and my face is already clearing up.
I just got this as part of the kit. I've only used it once and that may be it because i can't stand the smell! My whole face smells something like bacon. It's so weird to say but I can't stand it.
Dang I love this product so much. Love how it makes my skin feel. Such a bummer that it leaks pretty bad. Hard to justify for the price

My bf bought me this for a gift. I feel so bad cause it's just terrible. 1) the packaging/mixing process is stupid. 2) store it in the fridge? Really? I'm never going to go from washing my face in the bathroom, to the fridge and back to the bathroom 3) it's too liquidy. As soon as I squirt it in my hand, it's dripping thru my fingers. And the whole thing about storing it in the fridge.. so, should I go from bathroom, to fridge, squirt/apply in front of mirror, then put it back in the fridge? Who's got that time?? 4) it smells so bad. Can't stand it. 4) it's made my skin really dry and chalky.
I put this on every morning along with the protini and B Hydra.I have a nice glow and my makeup goes on so well! No fragrance added is the best part so I don't care what it smells like!
Followed instructions as described, shook vigorously. Powder was still in it and would not mix. Could not use.

avis.titre: Good product, terrible packaging for cost
avis.texte: I don't think I'm not getting full potency as powder is stuck to the bottom of tube. Took packaging apart to try to mix further and now it's broken and I can barely get the product out.

The pump on this product didn't work so I had to take the bottle apart. After doing so, I found that the bottle it came in was only half full. I'm not sure how well this product actually works because it a pain to use out of a ziplock bag.
This is the worst serum I've used , it smells horrible and is very sticky on the skin even with just one drop! I can't even use the rest o see how it works cuz I can get past the smell or stickiness.

I don't care how amazing the ingredients or results of this product could possibly be. This smelled so horrific, I had to rewash my face and scrub my hands several times to get rid of this hot garbage juice scent. And for that price? Are you for real?

avis.titre: tetrahexyldecyl ascorbate Is more effective than l-ascorbic
avis.texte: I have used this for about a month, and it does not compare to alternative products that contain tetrahexyldecyl ascorbate. My favorite is Image Skincare IMAGE MD restoring power-C serum. This leaves your skin bright and smooth after just a week or so.

DO NOT, I repeat, DO NOT put this on your skin! it gave me a severe case of fungal acne that continues to worsen a week later, and this is after ONE application. When I applied it my skin felt like I put a flame to it, and the day after it was raw/red.

I applied this ONCE, it left a white powdery residue when it dried, even though I made sure the solution and the powder completely dissolved. Burning sensation upon contact and dry red flaky raw skin after.

I am not picky at all when it comes to product smell nor do i ever leave reviews, but this smells like a literal body in a funeral home after its been embalmed. i washed it off my face after hours of feeling nauseous. never again.

I am not picky at all when it comes to product smell nor do i ever leave reviews, but this smells like a literal body in a funeral home after its been embalmed. i washed it off my face after hours of feeling nauseous. never again.

avis.titre: Am shocked how much I love this
avis.texte: This serum has blown my mind. My face has never been this soft & smooth & glowy, to where I actually look forward to using it every morning

This serum is AMAZING! I see results every time I use it and they are cumulative over time! I used to use more expensive brands, I know this one ain't cheap, but this is my new GO TO in my beauty routine! TRUST ME , JUST BUY IT!!!!!!!'
The smell and stickiness are so bad, I had to throw it away. It might work, but I will never know.

avis.titre: Good Product (refill options could be availabe)
avis.texte: I really like the product and use it daily! However, I could not find any refill options available, since the package is so durable it would not be a big issue to make it and be more eco.

I'm still young but having severe acne since being 12 and now dealing with acne spots, this product really helps. I bought the mini first and now I'm considering splurging and buying the full size version!

avis.titre: It seems to really lock in moister
avis.texte: I'm in my 50's and my skin has been changing a lot in the last few years (age spots, wrinkles, dryness, etc.). I've tried A LOT of different products. I've loved that this really makes my skin feel soft for hours, particularly when used in conjunction with Protini Polypeptide Firming Moisturizer - it seems to lock in moister all day. I've noticed my skin tone and dryness have improved (however, wrinkles just never seem to get better no matter what I try).

avis.titre: The smell is unbearable for me
avis.texte: I got this in the Drunk Elephant smalls package trial, and I will not be purchasing this serum ever again. The scent is extremely off putting, and I don't appriecate scented face products in the first place. I appreicate the glow it gives me and the hydration but the scent is terrible, it's just not a good smell.
This product started my obsession with Drunk Elephant. This is one product I can't live without. I recommend to all my friends if you only buy one thing this is the product.
Not a bad product, but I can't even write a proper review, because it's a struggle to use it every day due to smell. Something needs to be done. Smells like ham or dry dog bones. Unbearable.

Ive tried a bunch of vitamin C products for acne scarring, but this is the only one that seemed to work, and fast! The smell is obvious since there's no added fragrances. Vit C smells funky because thats how it smells. The formulation is wonderful, and definitely something to praise. I'm very happy I took the chance on this product, since this was my first Drunk Elephant purchase. My acne scarring is fading, and I feel more confident in my skin!
